# Project instructions

- Build a polished, responsive web-development guide that is free to access for all users.
- Keep the interface editorial and calm, with strong contrast, practical lessons, and clear navigation.
- Prefer complete user-facing functionality over decorative placeholders.
- Maintain accessible contrast and readable typography for all sections.
- Use Vite + React + TypeScript for this project.
- Verify the app with a production build before considering work complete.
